figures.caption: Figure 3: Synthetic verification. Panels 1–2: MZ-dom vs.MZ-match as a function of the dominance gap δ, with (iii) holding (ρ = 0.05) and failing (ρ = 0.55). Panels 3–4: Mπ-match vs.Mmarg as a function of κ, in the regimes κ ≤ 1 and κ > 1. Bands are 95% across-rep CIs.

Figure 4: Semi-synthetic results on MIMIC-III-SeS. Left: cumulative success rate vs. budget B under εperf . Right: mean λ̄ per stratum of |π(zi) − π(zj)| (low → high) on the Mπ-match-ranked pool of unit pairs; dashed red is the overall mean.
